replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Calculate the discriminant (D = b² - 4ac). If D is positive, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √D] / (2a). If D is zero, one solution exists. If negative, solutions are complex numbers. Always double-check your calculations.
